sanskrit_verse: वाग्दण्डश् चैव धिक्दण्डो विप्राधीनौ तु ताऊभौ । अर्थदण्डवधाव् उक्तौ राजायताव् उभावपि ॥
transliteration: vāgdaṇḍaś caiva dhigdaṇḍo viprādhīnau tu tāūbhau | arthadaṇḍavadhāv uktau rājāyatāv ubhāv api ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Verbal assault and contemptuous speech toward a Brahmin constitute actionable offenses; when financial penalty or capital sentence is prescribed, both the speaker and the ruler enacting such penalty assume equivalent karmic and administrative accountability.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in conscious alignment with Dharma, not coercive power
Causation arises from intent-laden speech patterns violating sacred order
Capacity-based responsibility extends equally to enactor and executor of unjust decree
Restoration logic demands dissolution of hierarchical distortion caused by disrespect to elevated consciousness
Consciousness alignment requires purification of speech as primary vector of societal harmony
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A utters vāgdaṇḍa OR dhigdaṇḍa TO agent B WHERE B.isBrahmin == TRUE THEN A.karmaDebt += HIGH
IF agent R enacts arthadaṇḍa OR vadha ON agent A THEN R.karmaDebt = A.karmaDebt
IF speech violation occurs THEN initiate śuddhiProtocol FOR both speaker AND judicial actor
IF disrespect to Brahmin detected THEN immediate realignment process initiated via NyayaSanjeevini Module
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any utterance violating the sanctity of a Brahmin invokes equal liability upon the presiding authority should punitive measures be enforced. The court must prioritize prāyaścitta (purification) over penalty, ensuring no hierarchical imbalance persists post-adjudication.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that disharmony originates from unregulated speech. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces karmic consequence to the speaker and enforcer alike. Responsibility is proportional to proximity to truth-consciousness. Non-punitive rule ensures correction through śuddhi rather than suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Śuddhi Protocol for purification of speech faculty
Vāk Siddhi Reintegration Process for restoring sacred communication
Karmic Debt Dissolution Mechanism for both offender and judge
Nyāyānanda Alignment Procedure to restore equilibrium between parties
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
